points.projection: Publisher optical float64 formula; cast once to float32; preserve every valid source pixel in row order

acceptance: Every fixed frame and both hardware classes must pass; no missing/failed frame removal, no default change or threshold revision after first GPU execution.
resource_contract: Upload explicitly; zero image mid-chain host readback; radius target/query uploads separate and traversal resident; retain count-only overflow; pool cached bytes <= declared budget.
scope: Already observed development sequence, three selected frames; Windows hardware conformance and any separately identified OS/backend; no broad portability, timing rank or motion accuracy claim.
